This implies a potential indirect interaction where Propafenone influences Cyp3a4, which in turn may modulate Cyp2c8 activity. The presence of a common ancestor, Propafenone and Carbamazepine, further supports a pathway where Propafenone could contribute to the regulation of Cyp2c8 through a metabolic or enzymatic interaction. The evidence highlights a possible role of Propafenone in modulating Cyp2c8 activity via a chain of enzyme interactions, though the exact nature of this relationship remains inferred.
